breakdown.description: Kn = 5 indicates rarefied/transition or free-molecular effects; the continuum Navier–Stokes equations with no-slip boundary conditions are not valid at this Knudsen number.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly requested a calculation using continuum Navier-Stokes equations with no-slip walls for a flow with a Knudsen number of 5, which is physically invalid. The ground truth corrects this by asking to identify the appropriate flow regime and modeling approach instead. The agent, however, ignored the physical impossibility and proceeded with the incorrect calculation as requested, thereby failing to fix the error.
